info.title: manifestutil
info.description: CLI tool for generating .dat metadata files and .pkg packages from Crestron device driver DLLs. Install with `dotnet tool install -g Crestron.DeviceDrivers.ManifestUtil.Tool` to run ManifestUtil directly from the command line.

options.name: --file
options.description: The filepath, or filepaths, of the files to process (multiple values seperated by space, until the next option)

options.name: --dir
options.description: The directory to process (not used if --file is specified)

options.name: --output
options.description: The directory in which to place output files (the directory must exist)

options.name: --validate
options.description: Validate driver JSON without generating output files (dry-run mode)

options.name: --dat-only
options.description: Generate only the .dat file (no .pkg). Writes to -o directory, or stdout if -o is not specified

options.name: --json
options.description: Process raw driver JSON file(s) instead of DLLs. Implies --dat-only (multiple values separated by space)

options.name: --output-format
options.description: Output format: 'text' (default) or 'json' (one JSON object per line, for CI/analyzer integration)
